annotations.title: Add documentation or a system prompt

description: Add a source of System knowledge by hand, as the Sources tab does: a document the agent answers from (a policy, an FAQ, a knowledge base page; kind documentation, the default) or a system prompt the agent is given (kind system_prompt). The same kind and name again saves a new version of it; that is how a source added by hand or seen in traces is edited. QualiLoop reads it into the knowledge and the judge reviews conversations against it. Sources in the agent's code are sent by the coding agent setup instead, and ones from the connection settings are changed there: saving over either is refused.

kind.description: documentation for a document the agent answers from; system_prompt for a prompt the agent is given, as written, with its placeholders.
kind.title: Kind

name.description: The source's name or path. The same kind and name again saves a new version.
name.title: Name

project.description: The project's number (as the app shows it, e.g. 12 or '#12') or its name. Optional when the organization has one project.
project.title: Project

name: save_documentation
